bio: On the bilgebarge, the Grim Tidings, no-one dare complain about the food. Unless they want Incizza's cleaver at their throat. A conventional cook he is not – his sous-chef and on-demand ink cannon is a voidsquid Incizza keeps caged on his back, and his food is often still writhing when it hits a pirate's plate. But grub's grub, and it does keep his crew in fine fettle.
